profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Building Scalable Digital Products | Engineering Leadership | Customer Experience | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Platform Modernization
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 11 years of experience building and improving large-scale digital products across eCommerce, retail, consulting, and industrial environments.

Throughout my career, I’ve focused on more than simply delivering software. I enjoy understanding the business problem behind a project, working closely with stakeholders, and helping teams turn complex requirements into reliable, practical solutions that create measurable value.

I’ve contributed to initiatives that improved application performance, strengthened platform reliability, simplified customer and operational workflows, modernized legacy systems, and made engineering teams more effective. I’m especially comfortable working on business-critical products where scalability, customer experience, reliability, and speed of delivery all matter.

I’m at my best in environments that value curiosity, accountability, continuous improvement, open communication, and collaborative problem-solving.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead the delivery and improvement of customer-facing and operational capabilities supporting product discovery, pricing, inventory visibility, ordering, and fulfillment across large-scale B2B commerce experiences.
- Improved application responsiveness and overall customer experience by identifying performance bottlenecks and driving improvements across critical user journeys.
- Partner closely with product, design, operations, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs and business priorities into practical, scalable solutions.
- Strengthened platform reliability by improving monitoring, troubleshooting practices, and visibility into production issues, helping teams identify and resolve problems faster.
- Promote engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, peer reviews, testing practices, and continuous improvements to the development and release process.
- Mentor engineers on problem-solving, system design, production troubleshooting, and balancing technical decisions with customer and business impact.
- Take ownership of complex initiatives from initial requirements and design through implementation, production release, and ongoing improvement.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered and modernized digital products for retail, eCommerce, SaaS, and enterprise clients, focusing on usability, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
- Led modernization initiatives that simplified legacy applications, improved customer and employee workflows, and reduced unnecessary complexity.
- Worked directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business challenges, clarify requirements, and turn them into actionable engineering solutions.
- Improved application performance and responsiveness by identifying bottlenecks across customer journeys and coordinating improvements across multiple parts of the platform.
- Connected business-critical systems and external services to streamline workflows and improve the flow of information across organizations.
- Helped teams improve delivery consistency through stronger review processes, automated quality controls, reusable patterns, and more reliable release practices.
- Mentored engineers through design discussions, code reviews, debugging sessions, and production-readiness decisions while encouraging greater ownership and independent problem-solving.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to high-scale eCommerce capabilities supporting customer experiences, product information, internal operations, and business-critical workflows.
- Improved the performance and reliability of customer-facing services by identifying bottlenecks, simplifying workflows, and strengthening system behavior under high demand.
- Partnered with product, user experience, infrastructure, and operations teams to deliver improvements while balancing customer impact, scalability, and operational risk.
- Strengthened production reliability through better monitoring, issue detection, incident response, and follow-up improvements.
- Participated in architecture and design discussions to ensure new capabilities could operate reliably as usage and business requirements grew.
- Supported controlled experimentation and incremental releases, allowing teams to validate changes while reducing risk to customers.
- Contributed to a strong engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, operational ownership, and collaborative problem-solving.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered customer-facing and internal enterprise applications for clients undergoing digital modernization and operational transformation.
- Helped replace manual and legacy workflows with streamlined digital experiences, improving efficiency and reducing unnecessary operational effort.
- Worked with business stakeholders to understand existing processes, identify pain points, and translate requirements into maintainable software solutions.
- Connected previously disconnected business systems, helping information move more efficiently between applications and teams.
- Supported modernization and cloud adoption initiatives that improved deployment consistency, application maintainability, and operational flexibility.
- Collaborated with globally distributed engineering, quality, design, and business teams to deliver projects across different time zones and organizational environments.
- Improved long-term maintainability through simplification, documentation, reusable patterns, and stronger development practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Industry · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built full stack features for IoT and industrial platforms that processed sensor data, device activity, and field operation events.
- Developed dashboards and web interfaces that made equipment status, operational metrics, and sensor readings easier for users to understand and act on.
- Created backend APIs and frontend views for connected devices, industrial data sources, and internal business tools.
- Improved reliability of field-facing applications by fixing production issues, improving error handling, and simplifying support workflows.
- Collaborated with engineers and business stakeholders to shape features from early concept through production release.
